note: Allein lebt auch der Hanqiugi laut Profil ganz natürlich: Einzelgänger und Paare suchen sich einen Apex-Fleischfresser als Begleiter, reiten an seiner Seite und lernen seine Rufe. Das ist der Trauerdrongo. Die zeternde Elsternschar tritt zurück, die Hausratte bleibt: Du lebst von den Resten deines Riesen und hältst lange Durststrecken aus.

analogs.covers: Solo life: a lone rider that attaches itself to a big animal, copies its calls and lives off what it stirs up and leaves behind
Body and grit: a hardy climber that lives off whatever its host leaves behind and gets by on very little

solo.headline: A drongo that picked a giant, with a rat's grit: you ride an Apex carnivore along the dry rock and the salt coast, copy its calls and live off its scraps.
solo.playsLike: You are a Hanqiugi: you go for longer without food and water than the others, so long, dry trips with your giant suit you. Alone you choose an Apex carnivore as your companion. You follow it with soft chirps until it has tolerated you for half a day, then you latch onto its side, ride along and learn its calls. You never help it: when it enters an engagement you let go, hide silently and only cheer it up afterwards. You eat carrion, insects and critters, hunt Juvenile-and-younger Deinonychus, Latenivenatrix, Psittacosaurus and Struthiomimus with copied calls as a lure, and chase Rhamphorhynchus. You flee from anything you cannot hunt and from Hatzegopteryx, Quetzalcoatlus, Megalania, Kelenken, Thalassodromeus and Tropeognathus. Other Microraptor near your companion get a ground challenge in your own voice.

why.text: Solitary Microraptor “may claim a carnivore companion” and “only attempt to create bonds with Apex Carnivores”. Fork-tailed drongos attach themselves to meerkats, babblers and big grazers and follow them all day.
Once allowed to latch on, it begins to “pick up on the calls of the carnivore” and mimics them back. Drongos copy the calls of the animals they live with.
On a hunt it may “utilize the calls of other species in an attempt to distract their prey”, the way a drongo's false alarm calls make meerkats drop their food.
Solitary Microraptor find “increased happiness in following other species about” and switch companions “on a whim”, just as drongos change hosts during the day.
Where its giant roams through dry country it copes best: Hanqiugi “are able to go for longer without food and water”, like a black rat living off the scraps of a bigger animal.

notLike: Drongos are fearless and mob eagles; a Microraptor flees at the first sign of aggression and leaves its companion the moment an engagement starts.
Drongos catch insects in flight; Microraptor glides from trunk to trunk and finds its food on the ground and in the trees.
solo.summary: Solo bist du ein Trauerdrongo mit der Zähigkeit einer Hausratte. Du folgst einem Apex-Fleischfresser mit leisem Zirpen, bis er dich einen halben Tag geduldet hat, dann klammerst du dich an seine Seite und reitest mit ihm über trockenen Fels und an der salzigen Küste entlang. Als Hanqiugi hältst du länger ohne Futter und Wasser durch, lange Wege ohne Süßwasser machen dir weniger aus als den anderen. Du lebst von seinen Resten, von Aas, Insekten und Kleintieren. In seine Kämpfe und Jagden mischst du dich nie ein: Beginnt ein Kampf, springst du ab, versteckst dich still an Klippe oder Palme und munterst ihn erst danach mit Cheer Up auf. Andere Microraptor an deinem Begleiter forderst du am Boden mit deiner eigenen Stimme heraus.
